evidence_object: Presence/similarity of a supplied reference library in an APK, with class/package mappings; not evaluated unique-version recovery.

evidence_object: Repeated library candidates, scanner/API-defined potentially malicious libraries, static exposed-path indicators and certificate-owner connections.

title: in-toto: Providing Farm-to-Table Guarantees for Bits and Bytes

claim_ceiling: Layout-conforming process provenance and scoped authorization, augmented only by the properties actually checked by trusted inspections or rebuilders; not an unrestricted benign-behavior guarantee.
